name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
title: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd - 543980 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capex-heavy expansion to ~2,900 beds funded by accruals and debt capped at 3x EBITDA; Dombivli opened early but Indore occupancy only ~45-50% and Dombivli burns INR2-3 crore a month, so supply is rising while utilisation is still ramping.

utilisation.quote: the bed occupancy for the 3 pre-existing hospitals stood at 61.2%

capex.quote: we deployed around INR500 crores in capex this year, Dombivli, BKC land payment , and ongoing Pune and Mira Road projects

triggers.label: 1,700 new beds; ~2,900 total
triggers.quote: we are looking at approximately 1,700 new beds in this expansion cycle, taking our long-term capacity to nearly 3,000 beds

triggers.label: Indore occupancy just under 50%
triggers.quote: the occupancy currently is just under 50% now

triggers.label: Dombivli breakeven in year 2
triggers.quote: we remain confident about achieving the year 2 breakeven that we guided to

guidance.value: INR2-3 crore per month average for FY27
guidance.quote: we have said between INR2 crores to INR3 crores a month on an average for the whole year
calendar year end of, '27, '28, you should expect it
with a currently self-imposed ceiling of 3 times of EBITDA
it is likely to happen between 6 to 12 months

prior_guidance_check.quote: We had set ourselves a target of commissioning it by Q1 FY27, and I'm very pleased that we beat that and opened ahead of schedule.
Pune South is on track to open in calendar year '28, as we had committed.

red_flags.label: Land payment and BKC approvals pending
red_flags.quote: it is still in the regulatory clearance, and prepossession formalities are underway with MMRDA

red_flags.label: Rupee and capex cost inflation
red_flags.quote: the only thing that I am watching out for very keenly is the depreciating rupee and the cost of capex

evasions.quote: I can't really predict regulatory timelines.
Detailed calculations, of course, we will do subsequently.
Unfortunately, I don't have too much more to say.
